proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13415 sindhu gives Khowar sin and L. sinnh/sĩdh river. The s-initial river forms fit; Bshk nīn needs comparison with nadī rather than an assumed s-loss. Reviewed comparison: Kho sīn “river” (f_i6hrwimekxtfw). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
